title: Survey
description:
This task is less about Karol and more about you. How are you doing with your learning? How can I help you make learning even better?

Fill out the survey by setting the variables to the appropriate values. When you are done, click on `Start` and your answers will be submitted.

Broke something? You can reset your code in the menu.
questScript:
__ide_run_client()
__karol = Robot()

if not isinstance(aussage1, int) or not 1 <= aussage1 <= 5:
    __ide_prompt("🐞 Statement 1: Please choose a number between 1 (strongly disagree) and 5 (strongly agree).", "OK")
    __karol.beenden()

if not isinstance(aussage2, int) or not 1 <= aussage2 <= 5:
    __ide_prompt("🐞 Statement 2: Please choose a number between 1 (strongly disagree) and 5 (strongly agree).", "OK")
    __karol.beenden()

if not isinstance(aussage3, int) or not 1 <= aussage3 <= 5:
    __ide_prompt("🐞 Statement 3: Please choose a number between 1 (strongly disagree) and 5 (strongly agree).", "OK")
    __karol.beenden()

if not isinstance(verbessern, str):
    __ide_prompt("Free text 1: Expected a text.", "OK")
    __karol.beenden()

if len(verbessern) == 0:
    __ide_prompt("Please enter something in Free text 1.", "OK")
    __ide_exit()

    
if not isinstance(spaß, str):
    __ide_prompt("Free text 2: Expected a text.", "OK")
    __karol.beenden()
    
if len(spaß) == 0:
    __ide_prompt("Please enter something in Free text 2.", "OK")
    __ide_exit()

if not isinstance(zustimmung, bool):
    __ide_prompt("Consent: Expected True or False.", "OK")
    __karol.beenden()

event_str = f"{aussage1}_{aussage2}_{aussage3}_{zustimmung}_{verbessern.replace('_', '-')}_{spaß.replace('_', '-')}"

if len(event_str) >= 999:
    __ide_prompt(f"Maximum length exceeded by {len(event_str) - 998} characters. Please shorten your answer or send it directly to karol@arrrg.de, thanks!")
    __karol.beenden()

__ide_submit("karol-survey", event_str)

__karol.schritt(2)
__karol.linksDrehen()

__ide_prompt("Thank you for taking part in the survey!", "close")
__ide_set_progress(True)
